faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ARI Pune Project Associate I Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the ARI Pune Project Associate I Recruitment is 11 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate I at ARI Pune?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.Sc./M.Tech degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Bioinformatics. Experience in NGS data analysis for microbial genomics is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate I position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate I post will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ARI Pune Project Associate I Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link before the last date. Ensure all details are accurate and documents are uploaded correctly.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ARI Pune Project Associate I Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100/- for General/OBC category candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate I role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate I position involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Project Associate I post at Agharkar Research Institute is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is ARI Pune located?
faq.answer: Agharkar Research Institute (ARI Pune) is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411004.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ADVT/Rect/MACS-ARI/12/ARI-004/2026-27.
